meta.themes: Efficient Models Arrive, Enterprise Agents Consolidate, Local AI Infrastructure Expands, Agent Safety Gets Operational

news.title: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5 for high-volume agent work
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 as its fastest small model, priced about 75% lower per task than Haiku 4.5 and tuned for summaries, subagents, browser use, and other high-volume workloads.

news.title: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6 in ChatGPT with responses that can combine text, visuals, and interactive tools while continuing to stream findings during longer reasoning and tool-use work.

news.title: Google introduced a universal Gemini agent for enterprise work
news.summary: Google Cloud introduced the Gemini agent as a governed enterprise system that can use business context, tools, connectors, and multiple models to complete knowledge work, media, data, and coding tasks.

news.title: Atlassian expanded its OpenAI partnership across Rovo and its platform
news.summary: Atlassian and OpenAI expanded their agreement to put GPT-6-family models behind Rovo agents and connect them with Atlassian's Teamwork Graph, while more than 3,000 Atlassian developers use Codex.

news.title: SAP agreed to acquire AI work-intelligence company TechWolf
news.summary: SAP agreed to acquire TechWolf and bring its organizational context graph, AI models, and research team into SuccessFactors to support skills mapping, workforce planning, and organizational redesign.

news.title: Biohub partners committed $1.8 billion to AI-ready biology data
news.summary: The US government, Meta, Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and Biohub committed $1.8 billion to create standardized biological datasets for predictive AI models that could accelerate drug research.

news.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft opened RTX Spark Windows systems for preorder
news.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft opened preorders for RTX Spark laptops and previewed DGX Station for Windows, bringing the NVIDIA AI stack and local agent workloads to laptops and compact desktops.

news.title: Google and Constellation signed a deal to add 890 MW of nuclear capacity
news.summary: Google and Constellation signed a 20-year agreement to add 890 MW of nuclear capacity to the PJM grid and pair Gemini Enterprise with grid operations under an expanded technology alliance.

news.title: EU tech chief said the AI Act can address risks from rogue agents
news.summary: EU technology chief Henna Virkkunen said the AI Act covers the full model lifecycle and can address emerging agent risks as regulators assess safety and transparency responses from more than 30 companies.

news.title: AWS released a SageMaker inference-optimization skill for coding agents
news.summary: AWS released an MCP-compatible skill that lets Kiro, Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents benchmark SageMaker endpoints, compare configurations, and generate reviewable Python SDK code.

news.title: GitHub made local sandboxing generally available for Copilot agents
news.summary: GitHub made local sandboxing generally available across Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and VS Code Agent Host, with policies for filesystem, network, credential, MCP, and language-server access.

news.title: Anthropic expanded verified access to advanced cyber capabilities
news.summary: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program to three access tiers for qualified defenders after partners reported at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities found with Claude models from April through July.
